# Twelve or Twenty-Four, As You Set It

Version 1.7.3 is a small fix release: the warning times now follow the 12-hour or 24-hour setting in your Home Assistant profile.

## Fixes

- **The time format in your profile is respected again.** The card compared the profile setting against the wrong values, so it never recognised "12 hours" or "24 hours" and always fell back to the convention of your language. An English profile set to 24 hours showed "3:05 PM", and a German profile set to 12 hours showed "15:05". Both settings now apply as chosen, and "Auto (use language setting)" behaves as before. Thanks to @SeoFood for finding and fixing this. _[#77]_

## Under the hood

- **Updated build and test tooling.** The development dependencies are current again, including a patched `source-map-js`. None of them ship in the card itself. _[#78]_ _[#79]_
